name: Frame Sequential
summary: Left and right eye frames are presented alternately at high refresh rate (typically 120Hz, 60Hz per eye). The display or glasses sync to the alternation. Used by active-shutter glasses systems, OLED panels with WibbleWobble, and some projectors.

variants.name: 120Hz (60Hz per eye)
variants.description: Standard frame sequential. Display runs at 120Hz, alternating left/right at 60Hz each. Used by Nvidia 3D Vision, active-shutter 3DTVs, and WibbleWobble OLED setups.

variants.name: 240Hz (120Hz per eye)
variants.description: High-refresh variant for 240Hz displays. Smoother per-eye motion. Rare — requires a 240Hz display and compatible output pipeline.

hardware_requirements: Active shutter glasses or compatible panel
